frozen_predictor: bootstrap ensemble U3, first 10 accepted bootstrap models, M=2000
horizon_ablation: 31-point moving average of calibration median standardized absolute error, normalized to median one
primary_guarantee: marginal whole-trajectory coverage over the defined episode population; no conditional guarantee

decision_rule.sufficient: B2 pooled MACE <=.05, pooled 95% >=.90, every category 95% >=.88, width <=3x B0 and <=5 K
decision_rule.regime: pooled adequate, a category <.88, and Mondrian improves minimum by >=.05
decision_rule.too_conservative: coverage adequate but width rule fails
